findings.ref: staged resolver _recover_journal / _legitimate_journal_bundles (bundle-shape check) vs T-007.contract.json comment and implementation report Round 15
findings.note: The round-15 remedy does not close the attack class the contract and the report both say it closes. _legitimate_journal_bundles constrains only the SET of journal-listed paths, not the per-entry PRE/POST encoding. Take the Full-track set the check itself accepts, which main() builds as facet-manifest.yaml + generated/project-context.resolved.json + resolver-evidence.yaml. A committed journal naming exactly those three, with pre_hash ABSENT plus post_hash equal to the live facet-manifest bytes on the first entry and the true live hashes as pre_hash on the other two, passes every guard: each path is in the allowed set, none repeats, the frozenset IS the Full-track bundle, and _read_journal imposes no hash-consistency rule. States classify as post/pre/pre, which is MIX, the only writing branch. The pre-image validation loop skips post entries whose pre_hash is ABSENT, so no backup is needed; _restore_to_pre then unlinks the live facet-manifest.yaml; the confirmation loop passes because _live_digest of a missing file returns ABSENT, and _discard_batch reports success. That is the identical 'MIX rollback unlinks a live artifact that was never part of any transaction' outcome the round-14 finding named, reachable with a bundle-shaped journal instead of a subset one. The new fixture (in-set-non-bundle) and mutant G cover only the subset variant, so nothing in the suite would notice. Mitigating, and why this is Major rather than Critical: the owner already ruled the round-1 class (attacker content reaching an in-set target through a supplied pre-image backup) out of scope, and a clean resolve republishes the deleted artifact. The defect here is that the contract comment and the report assert the class is closed when the strictly-equivalent full-bundle path remains open and untested.

findings.ref: T-007.contract.json comment; implementation report Test Evidence Test Result field; CHANGELOG.md T-007 entry
findings.note: The declared green tally is stale by eight in all three artifacts, and disagrees with the very captures they name. Every green capture in the bundle reports 369 passed, 0 failed: the two contract-declared green_evidence files (qg/T-007/focused-tests-sh.log and focused-tests-ps1.log), both green-shipped captures, and the CLEAN CONTROL run at the top of mutation-proofs.log. The contract nevertheless says 361/0, the report's headline Test Result field says 361 passed / 0 failed while pointing at the green-shipped captures, and the CHANGELOG entry says 361 passed / 0 failed. This is a verbatim recurrence of the round-11 Major (contract said 355 while its captures said 356) that round 12 claimed to fix structurally; ironically the contract states 361 three times in the same comment that declares THE GREEN TALLY IS STATED ONCE ON PURPOSE. It is a required-check declaration disagreeing with its own evidence, on the field a reader checks first.

A count asserted as verified by execution but contradicted by the artifacts in the same document is the third instance of this class in this bundle.
